title: Decent Clear Hangers for Lightweight Light Strands
text:
Decent Clear Hangers for Lightweight Light Strands. These clear hangers will work perfectly if you want to hang fairy lights or even the smaller Christmas style light strands - though you will have to use more of them and likely need to use a nail to attach.

I have utilized these in multiple locations, some with more success than others. I have found these perform far better indoors rather than out and it is critical that the surface be prepped prior to adhering the clip. Should there be any dust or debris these will not bond properly.

Something that is important to note - these will damage interior walls. The glue used on these clips is not similar to what is used by Command Strips brand clips so when you remove these clips it is difficult to do so without damaging the wall beneath.

I have had great luck using these to hang decorations in odd locations where I could not use any other method and these have proven to be more effective than I anticipated. By utilizing 2 clips in succession they can support far more weight than a singular clip - this has come in handy for hanging a few odd Halloween decorations.

This is a great set to have on hand. Understand the potential issues and avoid them. These can be used in really effective ways.

product_metadata.title: 48 Pack Mini Adhesive Light Clips , All-Purpose Holiday Light Clips, Clear, Small Decorating Wall Hanging Hooks for String Lights, Christmas Light Clips Indoor, Outdoor, Party Lights Hangers Hooks
features: 【Mini but Multi-Function】: Made of PE material and the diameter of these the clear hook is 17x8mm, which is higher invisible and strength. It can be used to hang, wind, organize and hold various light wires.(wires below 5mm). Miniature & Neutral Clear Colored ensuring they do not stand out when used for hanging led string lights, fairy lights, rope lights, triangle flags, cables and indoor outdoor Christmas decor.

【Two fixing methods(adhesive or nail)】 : One is to stick the hooks to a flat surface directly, such as glass,marble, tile, wall , mirror, stainless steel or any flat; the other is that these can be fixed on an exterior wall or wooden surface with 1-inch nails (there is a small hole in the middle of the clip), Suitable for indoor, wall, kitchen, hotel lobby, windows, eaves, corridor, fence, trees and others.

【Two ways for using (Hung or Wound)】: The wire that is below 5mm can be hung with these clips, and lock it with 2 pins on hook; The other is that the light wire can be wound on the center pillar of the hooks to fix the wire safely and stably.

【Easy Installation】: These clips with 0.5mm strong adhesive, they can hold up the maximum weigh of 0. 5 lb when it is fully glued. Just paste on a flat surface after tearing off the covered paper.The steel nail can also be put into the center hole of clips if it is on the rough surface, and fix the steel nail with a hammer directly without hand support.

【New 48 Mini white adhesive hooks】: 48 pieces clear string Light clips with transparent double-sided tapes included. Suitable for the almost of led string light for Christmas Decor , such as fairy light, rope light, string light, photo clips light ,curtain light and so on.
